lead.t: Boutonniere(buttonhole) deformity caused by PIP flexion and DIP hyperextension- as a result of splitting of the extensor tendon which results in the head of the proximal phalanges poking through like a button.

Intermembranous ossification( skull, clavicle).\nBones without physes ( pelvis, carpals) grow by apposition from their surrounding perichondrium/osteum while others such as phalanges and spine use both
Radial nerve cutaneous distribution: dorsal surface of the lateral 3½ digits (over the proximal phalanges) and the dorsum of the lateral hand.
